theme_plan_amendment.scope: Additive acceptance checks translated into stable T-prefixed check IDs; AUTH-P2-FINISH authorizes Phase 2 execution only

entry_gate: Previous phase completion and explicit owner authorization; recorded boundary exception may permit execution without claiming user acceptance
exit_gate: Required steps/checkpoints complete; review packet and explicit user acceptance before ordinary next-phase execution

steps.title: produce high-fidelity review artifacts
steps.work: create linked screens or dependency-free prototypes for importing a screenshot, correcting an extraction, studying a passage, attempting PQP practice, and resuming work. Include empty, loading, error, offline, and success states. Use actual source-derived content privately and safe fixtures in public history.
steps.deliverables: reviewable design prototype and annotated interaction specs, including selected 3D storyboard only where instructional value exists.
